newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turkey to build second intl. airport in Istanbul.
newsitem.headline: Turkey to build second intl. airport in Istanbul.

text.p: Turkey is to build a second international airport in Istanbul within the next two years and has secured the necessary financing for the project, the state-run Anatolian news agency said on Thursday.
The agency quoted Deputy Prime Minister Tansu Ciller as saying that the airport will occupy an area of 6.5 million square metres on the Asian side of the city.
The Ataturk Airport, on the European shores of the Bosphorus Strait, currently handles all international and domestic commercial flights in and out of Istanbul.
Anatolian did not say how much the new airport project would cost.
